purpose: Split each already-frozen technical 16-way acquisition/measurement shard into deterministic colour-blind compute partitions so each hosted job remains bounded, then reassemble the exact original semantic shard before completeness evaluation.

trigger.reason: ROI-v4 development inference required 46008.10229420662 seconds for 400 images, while the locked test required 873.0979149341583 seconds for 100 images. Sequentially processing roughly 3,750 images per original shard risks exceeding a hosted-job execution ceiling.

partition.assignment: sha256('fcp-atlas-v5-compute-partition\x1f' + measurement_id), first eight digest bytes as unsigned big-endian integer modulo 16

ephemeral_firewall.rule: The acquisition step may read only its sealed coordinate key and v5 firewall. Before measurement estimator construction, copy the location-blind worker manifest to a clean directory and delete the downloaded preimage packet, including the sealed acquisition key. The measurement step receives only the location-blind worker manifest, blinded image objects, frozen ROI assets and its compute-partition indices.

reassembly.expected_membership_rule: The union of 16 compute partitions must equal exactly the measurement IDs assigned to that original semantic shard by the unchanged v5 measurement_shard rule.
reassembly.canonical_output: one measurement_v5_shard_XXXX.csv plus manifest per original semantic shard

unchanged: two torch threads per measurement worker
claim_ceiling: Compute scheduling only. This amendment cannot change image admission, colour values, species/cohort membership, inferential statistics, branch outcomes or biological claims.
